system.flavor: Fold a wall of dense space into being.

body.label: Target
body.html: A line of open spaces within 5 units.

body.label: Effect
body.html: Fold a wall of dense space up to 3 units long until the start of your next turn. It blocks movement and line of sight through its spaces and provides Cover.

surges.html: A creature the wall would form on top of is pushed 1 unit to the nearest open space.
Creatures benefiting from the wall's Cover gain an additional +1 Defense.

rider.title: SPACE - THREAD
rider.html: Create a Space Thread. When a future Magecraft Action grants Defense or creates Cover, consume it to increase one such bonus by 1.
